from slugify import slugify
cases = [
    ("Hello World", None, "hello-world"),
    ("a -- b!!c", None, "a-b-c"),
    ("Hello World", "_", "hello_world"),
    ("Crème Brûlée", None, "creme-brulee"),
    ("Ñandú", None, "nandu"),
]
ok = True
for text, sep, want in cases:
    got = slugify(text) if sep is None else slugify(text, sep=sep)
    flag = "PASS" if got == want else "FAIL"
    if got != want: ok = False
    print(f"{flag}  slugify({text!r}"+(f", sep={sep!r}" if sep else "")+f") -> {got!r} (want {want!r})")
print("ALL PASS" if ok else "FAILURES")
